title: External program launched through NSTask in objc — review required
description: NSTask launches an executable with a path and argument array supplied by the app. When the launch path or arguments come from a document, a URL handler or user input, the app runs code the user did not choose. The rule flags the launch; whether any component is externally influenced is a review decision.
remediation: Hard-code the executable path, validate arguments against an allowlist and never derive the launch path from document content.
limitation: Lexical: matches NSTask allocations; Process on newer SDKs is reported by the same intent but not by this pattern.
